pulse.label: Five starters and one Carmen Mesa. Who is the odd arm out?

anchorFacts: Five starters and one Carmen Mesa. Who is the odd arm out?

Pablo Almanzar took the rotation spot most expected Carmen Mesa to fill, then threw a no-hitter in his debut and a 1-hitter to close the ALCS. That leaves the rotation full with Coles, Ramos, Rivas, Ellis and Almanzar. Mesa sits at AAA on a $780K deal with nowhere to start in Oakland. Henry Rivas is the most expensive arm at $28. 2M and missed time this season before his complete game in World Series game 4.
Is Mesa the A's best trade chip this winter, and how long does the front office keep paying top dollar for Rivas while the cheap arms win?
